title: Wilton candy melters
text: Wilton candy melters. If I could rate these 6 stars, I would.  I don't make candy---- BUT... we have annual seafood boils and it a constant challenge to keep enough butter melted and warm... I bought 2 of these and they worked P E R F E C T L Y!!!  Kept the butter perfectly melted and just the right temp!  There are 2 temperature choices... we used the higher of the two to melt the butter (we had cut into small cubes to help melt) and then used the lower temp to keep the butter melted and warm. They have a cord (two prong) with a fairly long cord for plugging in. The "pots" are top rack dishwasher safe and are a soft, silicon matter with a blue plastic rim and handle. The pots lift right out of the warming unit for easier cleaning.  No medal on the pot to worry about burning yourself on.. we have small stainless sauce cups (also purchased on amazon) to pour the butter into and use, so the spouts on the pots are again.. PERFECT. Sooooo... if you're looking to melt chocolate, I'm sure they work for that too...  :)  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Candy Melts Candy And Chocolate Melting Pot, 2.5 Cups
features: MADE EASY: Make chocolate covered strawberries, chocolate covered pretzels, cake pops and more with the Wilton melting pot. With an ergonomic, heat-resistant handle and two easy-pour spouts - perfect for pouring melted candy into a decorating bag or drizzling directly onto treats

QUICK: The Wilton candy melts melting pot has two temperature settings, warm and melt so you can quickly melt up to 2 ½ cups of Candy Melts candy or chocolate in less than 10 minutes and keep it warm for dipping

PERFORMANCE: An innovative heating base stays cool to the touch, a safety light indicates when the Wilton pot is on and it has rubber feet to keep it steady on your counter. Has a polarized 120-volt plug and features two temperature settings, melt and warm

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Silicone insert is removable for easy cleaning and is dishwasher safe; wipe outside of the candy melts melting pot with a clean damp cloth (easy-to-clean and convenient removable silicone pot)
INCLUDES: 1 candy melts and chocolate melting pot, dimensions: 5.7 inches diameter x 6.3 x 9.1 inches (14.4 diameter x 16 x 23.1 centimeter)
